projectDescription: sb0t is a Windows-based Ares chat room server with a WPF GUI, JavaScript scripting engine, web client support, multi-server linking, and a full suite of moderation tools.
keyFeatures: Ares protocol TCP/UDP chat server with WPF GUI
JavaScript scripting engine powered by Jurassic for runtime automation
Web client (ib0t) support via WebSocket-based HTML5 interface
Multi-server linking (Hub/Leaf topology) for federated chat rooms
Comprehensive ban system: IP bans, range bans, ASN bans, GUID bans
Word filter with regex support and multiple enforcement actions
Captcha challenge system for joining users
Admin levels: Regular, Moderator, Administrator, Host
User account registration with password authentication
Virtual rooms (vrooms), user avatars, scribbles, and custom fonts
Chat history, greet messages, MOTD, and URL tags
Proxy detection and automatic ban expiry
publicApiSurface: scripting JS events: onJoin, onPart, onTextBefore, onTextAfter, onCommand, onTimer, onBotPM, onPMBefore, onLinked, onLeafJoin
JS global functions: user(), print(), sendPM(), sendText(), sendEmote(), include(), stripColors(), tickCount()
JS Room object: name, topic, botName, hashlink, externalIp, port, setUrl(), clearUrl()
JS Users object: local(), linked(), banned(), records()
JS Link object: connect(), disconnect(), leaves(), leaf(), linked, name, hashlink
